corrections.reason: The printed glyph is ፃ (ሕፃን, 'a youth/child', explaining why he would fear blood 'ደም ይፈራል' and contrasting with 'ጐበዝ' in the alternative interpretation), which was misread as ግ (ሕግን).

corrections.corrected_text: ነበረበት ፡ ሉቃ ፡ ፳፫ ፡ ፵፮ ። ም ፡ ፯ ፡ ፶፯ ።
